title: Source/pictogram allow-list (license terms + snapshot hash/archive)
context: Every admitted phrase or pictogram source must be license-cleared for derivative works and open release, with its exact terms, attribution, and required disclaimer recorded plus a snapshot hash/archive for later drift detection. The allow-list is the provenance backbone for the whole project. Items that cannot be cleared are never admitted.
objective: Build the source/pictogram allow-list capturing license terms, attribution, mandatory disclaimer, and a snapshot hash/archive per source.
acceptanceCriteria: sources/allow-list.yaml has >= 3 verified sources or original-authorship records, each with sourceId, license, disclaimerText, attributionTemplate, snapshotHash, snapshotArchiveUrl, verifiedBy, verifiedDate
Each entry states whether the item is clearable for derivative works/translation and open release; never assume CC0
Records the exact attribution string and any source-mandated disclaimer verbatim
Validates against allowListSchema and passes CI structural checks
